query: WITH filtered AS (SELECT image_digest, created FROM deployment_deploy_history WHERE deployment_id = $1 AND ($2::TEXT IS NULL OR image_digest = $2) AND ($3::TIMESTAMPTZ IS NULL OR created >= $3) AND ($4::TIMESTAMPTZ IS NULL OR created <= $4)) SELECT page.image_digest AS "image_digest?", page.created AS "created?", total.count AS "total_count!" FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM filtered) AS total LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM filtered ORDER BY created DESC LIMIT $5 OFFSET $6) AS page ON TRUE;
